notes: PROVISIONAL defaults pending a calibration pilot (docs/regime.md).
No model default: the runner refuses to launch without --model.

instances null = the 3 pre-registered worlds: orion-holdings, vega-group, lyra-partners. reps 6 = the pre-registered 3-world x 6-rep pilot (eval3-generative-vs-grounded.md section 9); 3 worlds x 5 arms x 6 reps = 90 cells.

arms: the three generative arms plus eval 2's ungrounded and grounded-iterate, re-run in the same regime so every contrast (the registered H1 per arm and H2 = grounded-iterate - gen-both, and the pooled readings) comes from one series, with one model.
isolation container: gen-code has bash and needs Docker. To run only the no-bash arms on a laptop: --isolation host --arms gen-figures,gen-both,ungrounded,grounded-iterate.

max_turns is the primary budget, set generously so that it is not the binding constraint; the clock sits well above the paper's 1500-1800 s. wall_clock_s and usd_rail are rails: a trial that hits one is scored (no deliverable = fail) and never retried.
bash_command_timeout_s: the per-command limit the gen-code prompt states (dbwm/eval3/prompt.py COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S); the harness must enforce the same value.
The paper's eval-3 regime was a dollar budget ($3, --max-budget-usd) and a clock. New runs pin turns instead (docs/regime.md, 'Why turns and not dollars') and are a new series.
